caveats: 109 table rows include stablecoins and multiple token representations; not equivalent to the RWA Count of 84.
Do not add RWA values to DefiLlama TVL; definitions and overlap differ.
Manager league-table shares use the provider-selected universe; do not sum with platform shares.
Explorer URLs are source references, not verified execution asset identifiers.
Scraped research data never authorizes execution or establishes availability, user eligibility, redemption, APY or venue liquidity.
Data is a dated snapshot. No live refresh or historical series is implied.

constraints: Chain TVL, stablecoin value, protocol capital and vault capital are distinct metrics and must not be added into one total.
Parent and child protocol rows may overlap. Do not sum protocol rows to recompute chain TVL.
Protocol percentage changes can describe the whole multichain protocol; they are not labeled Stellar-specific.
Snapshot observation time is not an upstream market as-of timestamp. Current feeds without an explicit upstream timestamp keep upstream_as_of null.
All data is for research. Live protocol state and verified canonical token identity are required before financial planning or execution.
Provider predictions are stored as provider interpretations, not guaranteed returns or Nest safety ratings.
Absent values stay null; missing supply/borrow fields are not zero.
RWA.xyz metrics and DefiLlama metrics remain separate; capital can overlap and must not be added into one ecosystem total.
Source observation times are retained per provider; this generated file is not a live market feed.
RWA display values, direction markers, rounding and nulls are preserved without inferring exact numeric values.
Protocol percentage changes may cover all chains; preserve the explicit scope.
All rows are for research. Verified canonical asset identities and fresh native venue state are required for financial actions.
Chart history, raw rendered page text, asset table cells and provider prediction fields are excluded from this initial payload.
